news_bbc.title: Jobless rate falls but small firms cut back hiring
news_bbc.summary: Small firms cite labour costs as a key factor in scaling back hiring, the Office for National Statistics says.

news_bbc.title: Chancellor rejects calls to raise Capital Gains Tax in Budget
news_bbc.summary: Influential Labour figures had been pushing for equalising CGT and income tax, but critics have said this could drive wealthy people out of Britain.

news_bbc.title: Burnham vows end to 'rip-off parking charges' under new rules
news_bbc.summary: The changes come after concerns that penalties issued by private providers are too harsh and leave motorists unfairly punished.

news_bbc.title: 'I'm fed up of swiping': Why singles now want to meet IRL
news_bbc.summary: The BBC hears from people who think dating events are better value for money than dating apps.

news_bbc.title: Revolut outage hits 'multiple services' as thousands of users report app issues
news_bbc.summary: Some users of the British neobank reported being unable to make some payments or access funds in its app on Tuesday.

news_bbc.title: How is the US economy really doing under President Trump?
news_bbc.summary: Ahead of the midterms Trump has boasted about the performance of the US economy. BBC Verify looks at inflation, jobs and economic growth in the country.

news_bbc.title: What is the Budget and what could be in it?
news_bbc.summary: Chancellor John Healey will set out his plans for UK taxes on 28 October.

news_bbc.title: Vinted blocks French looters listing stolen goods for sale
news_bbc.summary: The platform said since the weekend it had "taken immediate action to identify and remove listings linked to looting".
